=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:246-270 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: build_judge_semble_prefetch writes the full semble_query_block output to the context file without enforcing JUDGE_SEMBLE_CONTEXT_MAX_BYTES.
  WHY: Reviewers agree the live path bypasses the truncation the dead helper had, so Semble output can bloat judge prompts and hit token-limit/bounded-prefetch issues.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:9449-9524 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: RB_JUDGE_SEMBLE_CONTEXT_FILE is created in the review-blocked judge path but never cleaned up with rm -f.
  WHY: This is a low-impact temp-file hygiene issue in the runtime directory; reviewers note it does not cause a hard runtime failure.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:279-285 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The Semble query uses FIRST_ISSUE_BODY for "Original requirement:" without falling back to PR title/body when it is empty.
  WHY: For standalone review-blocked PRs without linked issues, Semble gets no requirement context, reducing its ability to find relevant code context.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:286-298 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: semble_query_block output is written to RB_JUDGE_SEMBLE_CONTEXT_FILE without any byte budget enforcement.
  WHY: Unbounded Semble context can bloat the review-blocked judge prompt and risk token-limit issues or degraded reasoning.
- tests/test_judge_semble_prefetch_contract.py:22-166 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: Tabs are mixed with 4-space indentation in the test module.
  WHY: Python can raise TabError/IndentationError on import or execution, which would break the test file before assertions run.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:247-266 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: build_judge_semble_prefetch writes the full semble_query_block output directly to the context file without enforcing JUDGE_SEMBLE_CONTEXT_MAX_BYTES.
  WHY: When Semble returns a large context block, the judge prompt receives unbounded Semble content, violating the bounded Semble prefetch contract and risking prompt bloat/token-budget issues.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:9524 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: RB_JUDGE_SEMBLE_QUERY_FILE is cleaned up, but RB_JUDGE_SEMBLE_CONTEXT_FILE is not.
  WHY: This leaves a temp file behind in RUNTIME_DIR; it is a minor hygiene inconsistency and does not cause a runtime failure.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:246-266 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: build_judge_semble_prefetch() doesn't enforce the byte budget for the Semble context it writes.
  WHY: The function writes the full output of semble_query_block directly to the context file without truncating to JUDGE_SEMBLE_CONTEXT_MAX_BYTES, which can make judge prompts exceed the intended bounded size.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:279 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The Semble query does not fall back to PR title/body when FIRST_ISSUE_BODY is empty.
  WHY: For standalone review-blocked PRs without linked issues, the Semble query has no requirement context, so Semble cannot effectively find relevant code context.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:286-298 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The semble_query_block output is written directly to RB_JUDGE_SEMBLE_CONTEXT_FILE without any byte budget enforcement.
  WHY: Unbounded Semble context can bloat the review-blocked judge prompts and exceed token limits.
- tests/test_judge_semble_prefetch_contract.py:29-46, 126-128, 155-158, 162-166 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The _run_render function and several test functions use tab characters for indentation while the rest of the file uses 4-space indentation.
  WHY: Python raises TabError/IndentationError on mixed indentation in some environments, causing the test suite to fail on import or execution.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:9524 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The review-blocked judge path cleans up RB_JUDGE_SEMBLE_QUERY_FILE but never cleans up RB_JUDGE_SEMBLE_CONTEXT_FILE.
  WHY: This is a minor temp-file hygiene issue in the per-run runtime directory and has low impact.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:246-264 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: build_judge_semble_prefetch() writes the full output of semble_query_block directly to the context file without enforcing the JUDGE_SEMBLE_CONTEXT_MAX_BYTES=12000 limit.
  WHY: Semble can return arbitrarily large context blocks, causing judge prompts to bloat past token limits and violate the bounded prefetch requirement.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:286-298 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The semble_query_block output is written directly to RB_JUDGE_SEMBLE_CONTEXT_FILE without any byte truncation or size cap.
  WHY: Unbounded Semble context can violate the bounded prefetch contract and cause token-limit issues in the review-blocked judge path.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:279-281 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The Original requirement section uses only FIRST_ISSUE_BODY with no fallback to PR title/body.
  WHY: For review-blocked PRs without linked issues, the Semble query contains no requirement context, so Semble may miss key information needed to find relevant code context.
- tests/test_judge_semble_prefetch_contract.py:32-46, 126-166 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The _run_render function and several test functions use literal tab characters for indentation while the rest of the file uses 4-space indentation.
  WHY: Python raises TabError: inconsistent use of tabs and spaces in indentation when the module is imported or executed, causing the test suite to fail immediately.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===

  WHY: Semble can return large result sets; the full output flows into the judge prompt's dynamic section, potentially exceeding the intended 12 KB budget and degrading judge reasoning quality.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:9449-9524 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The live path creates RB_JUDGE_SEMBLE_CONTEXT_FILE but never calls rm -f on it.
  WHY: The files land in ${RUNTIME_DIR} and may accumulate as orphaned files if the directory persists across runs; this is a low-impact hygiene issue.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:291-298 | confidence=4

  WHY: Unbounded Semble context flows into the review-blocked judge prompt, bloating token usage and risking truncation or malformed reasoning.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:279-281 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The Original requirement section uses only ${FIRST_ISSUE_BODY} with no fallback.
  WHY: When a review-blocked PR has no linked issues, the Semble query receives no requirement context, which degrades the quality of judge prefetch.
- tests/test_judge_semble_prefetch_contract.py:22-46, 126-166 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: These functions use literal tab characters for indentation while the rest of the file uses 4-space indentation.
  WHY: Python raises TabError: inconsistent use of tabs and spaces in indentation when the module is imported or executed, so the CI invocation will crash before any assertions run.
